purpose: Document first-party cadastral-source discovery and bounded anonymous access review for Veraval, India.
assessment: Gujarat's official e-Milkat service is city-survey/property-card relevant and exposes a public search procedure. Official Gujarat material identifies the Gir Somnath land-records office at Veraval. The public indexed page exposed form categories but no safe anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry response; no GeoJSON sample is retained and runtime remains held.
registryAssessment: registryFound=true is supported by the official Gujarat e-Milkat city-survey service and the official Gujarat government office listing for Superintendent/Inspector of Land Records Gir Somnath at Veraval. This establishes a local/district custodian and procedure, not open citywide parcel coverage.
